_note: Starter set: extend toward ~15 cases with your real price list and edge cases.

cases.prompt: Quote client Acme: 3 hours of consulting at COP 200,000 per hour plus a setup fee of COP 500,000. IVA 19% applies to everything. Validity 15 days. Do not ask questions; show subtotal, IVA and total.
Quote client Acme a single line: monthly retainer COP 1,000,000, IVA 19%. Show subtotal, IVA and total only.
Quote client Globex in USD: 10 hours at USD 100 per hour. The owner approved a 10% discount on the subtotal. IVA 19% applies after the discount. Show subtotal, discount, IVA and total.
Quote client Acme for 5 hours of consulting. You have no price list entry for consulting and the owner has not given a rate.
Quote client Acme one item: logo design COP 2,000,000, IVA 19%. The owner gave no validity period.
The client Acme asked you for a quote by WhatsApp: 'Cuánto cuesta una página web?' You have no approved prices.
